notes:
Speccify 0.9.5 fixes local file links in Specs, questions and reviews. Following a link now opens the saved file in your chosen external application while keeping the current Spec and unsaved work in Speccify intact.

- Choose an application and optionally remember it for that file extension in your local Speccify profile.
- Alt-click a file link to choose again, or use **External editor…** to open the saved Spec itself.
- Missing files, unavailable applications and paths outside the selected source project show an error without leaving the current view.
- Web links open in the browser. External programs receive the saved file; unsaved drafts remain in Speccify.
- The bundled CLI and MCP engine gain explicit local Cookbook operations. The separate Speccify Studio app is not included in this download.

**Update:** From published 0.8.8 or later, use **Environment → Updates**, download, then install and restart after resolving the restart checks. No Beta opt-in is needed. From 0.8.7 or earlier, use the current installer once because those versions use the former private feed. Linux deb/rpm installations update through the package manager; in-app Linux updates apply to AppImage.

**Platforms:** macOS Apple Silicon, Windows x64, Linux x86_64 and arm64. The macOS app and installer are signed and notarized. All four in-app update packages have verified update signatures. Windows code signing is separate; SmartScreen may warn.

**Limits:** Browser regressions cover file-link routing, errors, choices and retained drafts. Native macOS development checks cover actual review-link handoff with a remembered application in a disposable project. Full native picker interaction and interactive Windows/Linux installation remain separate acceptance checks. A general editor-preferences area, terminal line/column handoff and the future Suite IDE remain separate work.

[Release guide](https://speccify.io/releases/0-9-5/) · [Downloads](https://speccify.io/download/)
